title: $47 Drawer Fix for a Dark Pantry Cabinet
description: My base cabinet was 24 inches deep and I could never see past the first 8 inches of canned goods. Instead of reaching in blind, I pull the whole drawer out and see every can at once. It's the priciest item in my Costco pantry fix, but it solves depth, not clutter. Full comparison linked here.
